ns2:course.label: Electrophys Indic Aud Balance
ns2:course.description: Study of technical and clinical aspects of electrophysiologic measures of audition and balance; critical analysis of clinical and experimental literature; laboratory experience in electrophysiologic techniques. Prerequisite: SHS 240, SHS 450, SHS 550 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
